description: Schema definition used to create the Tag table (layer 2/9 of the Poutine League Dataverse data model build-out). Source of truth: ARCHITECTURE.md §1 (Data model).

table.purpose: Descriptive tag (classic, smoked meat, vegan, spicy, ...). Many-to-many with Poutine Submission (relationship deferred to layer 3, once Poutine Submission exists).

columns.notes: Primary name column, auto-created with the table.

solutionAttachment.issue: client.tables.create(..., solution="poutineleaguecore") did not auto-attach the table to the solutioncomponent list (same finding as layer 1).
solutionAttachment.remediation: pac solution add-solution-component --solutionUniqueName poutineleaguecore --component <EntityMetadataId GUID> --componentType 1 --environment <env>. Note: passing the SchemaName ('rpo_Tag') failed with 'Failed to resolve entity metadata' — the table's EntityMetadataId GUID (from client.tables.get) had to be used instead.

creationMethod.notes: No additional columns beyond the auto-created primary Name column were required per ARCHITECTURE.md §1 (Tag key field: Name only).
